disclaimer: Training and comprehension aid only. Users must answer truthfully based on their own N-400 and circumstances. Do not provide legal conclusions or coach concealment.

hardRules: Never randomly mix PERSONAL and ELIGIBILITY questions.
Complete or substantially complete the current sub-block before moving to the next.
Never ask every paraphrase of the same concept in one interview.
Use applicant profile data to determine applicable branches.
If the applicant answers YES to a sensitive eligibility concept, ask neutral factual follow-ups only; do not suggest a legal conclusion.
In Interview Mode, do not show Spanish translation before the applicant answers unless accessibility settings require it.
Civics is a separate module and must not be inserted randomly into N-400 review.

PERSONAL_TO_ELIGIBILITY: Now I am going to ask you some additional questions about your application.
Next, I will review some eligibility questions with you.
ELIGIBILITY_TO_OATH: Now I will ask you a few questions about the Constitution and the Oath of Allegiance.

selectionAlgorithm: Load applicant profile and filing basis.
Process PERSONAL sub-blocks in configured order.
For each concept, check conditions and whether concept ID has already been asked.
Choose one phrasing from canonicalPracticePrompt + alternatePhrasings.
Ask applicable follow-ups based on the applicant's answer and profile.
After PERSONAL is sufficiently complete, transition to ELIGIBILITY.
Process ELIGIBILITY sub-blocks in order with conditional branches.
